property_summary: After the owner calls NETM(), the owner's balance must equal totalDistributed (the mint to the owner), and any subsequent owner transfer of a bounded amount leaves balanceOf(owner) == totalDistributed - amount; the mutant never credits the owner, so the transfer reverts/balance check fails for some fuzzed amount.
change_summary: Delete the statement that assigns totalDistributed to the owner's balance, so balances[owner] is never set by NETM().
